candidate_actions: Exactly actions 0 ALL_LOCAL, 1 SPLIT1, 2 SPLIT2, 3 ALL_CLOUD; per-action repeated correctness, predictions, latency_ms, payload bytes, estimated energy, normalized components, M29 reward and means.

label.optimal_action: integer 0..3, or null for tied mean rewards
label.optimal_actions: all actions within configured tolerance of maximum mean reward
label.repeat_optimal_actions: argmax sets per repeat for stability inspection

metadata: Original v1 source metadata, intentionally preserves embedded source dataset_version; top-level dataset_version identifies v2.
repeats: 4, 8, 12 or 16; all four action positions equally represented
source_entries: Raw physical trace, live guard and v1 record for each execution. v1 reward placeholders remain unchanged.
state: Complete frozen v1 state: uncertainty, device, network, application. Required M25 fields non-null. Deferred v1 fields retain null.

units.energy: dimensionless estimated compute/payload proxy, never measured joules

validation: Rebuild all derived fields with M29; reject schema/type changes, missing metrics, state changes, duplicate executions, guard drift and wrong source/server evidence.
